key_catalyst: Escalating US-Iran conflict sends oil surging and yields higher, reversing risk-on sentiment
reasoning: The escalating US-Iran conflict is driving a sharper oil spike and higher yields than the similar event on 7/20, reversing the rate-cut optimism that fueled Tuesday's rally. Stalled diplomacy and continued airstrikes represent an unresolved, worsening threat that directly pressures rate-sensitive tech stocks. Combined with pre-earnings de-risking, this creates strong headwinds not yet fully absorbed by the market.
